definition: Multi-object tracker that decomposes dense target sets into sparse subsets via pseudo-depth estimation and performs hierarchical association within each depth layer

key_structural_ingredients.definition: Estimate relative depth from bounding box geometry (bottom y-coordinate)
key_structural_ingredients.notes: Using bbox bottom y-coordinate as depth proxy

key_structural_ingredients.definition: Partition detections and tracks into K depth layers using quantile-based binning
Perform Hungarian matching independently within each depth layer to reduce matching ambiguity
key_structural_ingredients.notes: Layer-wise matching followed by cross-layer fallback

key_structural_ingredients.definition: Match remaining unmatched tracks and detections across all layers
key_structural_ingredients.notes: Handles cases where track/detection depth assignments differ

key_structural_ingredients.definition: ByteTrack-style high/low confidence split for second-stage matching

assumptions: Bottom y-coordinate correlates with object depth (perspective projection)
Objects at similar depths are less likely to occlude each other
Decomposition reduces matching problem complexity per layer
deviations: Quantile-based layer boundaries instead of learned boundaries
